theorems.name: Submission.varifold_tangents_limit_ball_mass
theorems.statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclidean N)) (V : Varifold N n U) (x : Euclidean N) (θ₀ : ℝ) (C : Varifold N n (univ : Set (Euclidean N))), HasDensity n V.weight x (ENNReal.ofReal θ₀) → IsVarifoldTangent V x C → ∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → C.weight (closedBall 0 ρ) = ENNReal.ofReal θ₀ * unitBallVolume n * ENNReal.ofReal ρ ^ n
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
